title: Online fulfilment business: Hong Kong deep edition

questions.q: In "Read your local market Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Protect the seller and buyer data: store only name, address, phone and order lines; limit who sees it.
Serve one type of seller and one product size first; a wide service hides what works.
Price per order: pick, pack, label, storage and returns; check the margin.
Contribution per unit = price minus the cost of each unit.

questions.q: In "Choose your sector Analyse", which of these is a key idea?
o: Break-even units = fixed monthly cost divided by contribution per unit; round up.
Compare three models: own warehouse, shared space, a partner who packs. Pick by cost per order.
Written terms, rest days and paid leave follow the employment law; keep signed copies. Check with a local expert.
Direct marketing needs a clear choice for the customer to say no; keep that record.

questions.q: In "Register and license Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Some activities need an extra licence (food, health, money, education centres). List yours before you take a first order. Check with a local expert.
Protect the seller and buyer data: store only name, address, phone and order lines; limit who sees it.
Partner with a college, training body or business chamber to find helpers and to practise.
Trust: put the business registration number, a real address and a refund note on every page. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Protect data and customers Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: One measure per week: enquiries, orders or revenue; pick one.
Contribution per unit = price minus the cost of each unit.
Money moves fast by bank transfer and fast-payment apps; customers expect instant confirmation.
Sending data outside the city may need a safeguard; check with a local expert and list every tool that stores customer data.

questions.q: In "Find and serve customers Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Check against a worse case: if sales are 25% lower, do you still cover costs?
Keep a risk list with a response for each; include a rules change. Check with a local expert.
Payments: bank transfer and fast-payment apps first; give an instant receipt.
Partner with a college, training body or business chamber to find helpers and to practise.

questions.q: In "Price, tax and money Evaluate", which of these is a key idea?
o: Language: show both languages side by side; keep prices in HKD only.
List the business licence, storage rules, tax set-up, customs rules and goods you may not hold. Check with a local expert.
Trust: put the business registration number, a real address and a refund note on every page. Check with a local expert.
Write HKD next to every number.

questions.q: In "People and partners Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Channels: messaging apps, social media and marketplaces are where customers already are.
Payments: bank transfer and fast-payment apps first; give an instant receipt.
Three languages in daily use: your page in two (Traditional Chinese and English) is the minimum.
Written terms, rest days and paid leave follow the employment law; keep signed copies. Check with a local expert.

questions.q: In "Launch plan and review Create", which of these is a key idea?
o: Channels: messaging apps, social media and marketplaces are where customers already are.
A monthly review: what we planned, what happened, what we change.
Money moves fast by bank transfer and fast-payment apps; customers expect instant confirmation.
Direct marketing needs a clear choice for the customer to say no; keep that record.
